text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My vision is all hazy... I can't tell if my
legs feel
light or heavy... And to make
matters worse...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That's it! Go for it, Mrmrmrmrmr!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Shmshmshmshsmshm!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No. All those eyes... Someone else has
stolen
them...
I have to get them back...
right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Clearly in a daze, Aston Machan looks
up into the
roaring stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hsssss... Thanks for the awesome race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Crshshshshsh! I'm coming to your next race, too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't quite make out the expression on
her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way home, Aston Machan stares
out the
window, looking more distracted
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
No reporters came to talk with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan blazed around the track

today—her signature short stride as
powerful as
ever. It was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's customary for interviewers to crowd
around
the Umamusume who do well in
G1 races. We
wait for the press to come
our way after the race,
but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Can I have a comment?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! What are your thoughts on
today's race?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, I'm over here, you know.
Machan's over
here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm right here...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought I ran well today, but... does
this mean I
still have a long way to go?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First the blog, then the reporters... Not
even the
fans paid any attention to me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I feel like I'm wilting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This would be unimaginable under
ordinary
circumstances. That said,
interviews might be
customary, but
they're not a requirement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try, I can't come
up with an
answer. For now, we need a
change of pace. I
look over to tell Aston
Machan as much, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spin around in a panic. The only person
nearby is
a young man I've never seen
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance at the seats across from me, at
the train
doors, and even into the next
car over, but find
only the faces of
complete strangers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing else has changed—she's the
only one
who's disappeared.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Are you okay? Are you hot? You're
sweating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly wipe my face. Was that a
daydream just
now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right, Trainer? Has spring
turned
against you as well?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go look at the cherry
blossoms on
the way home? As two
people who need to
improve our
relationship with spring, it would do
us
good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When we reach the main plaza, I see
throngs of
students standing around and
taking pictures of
the cherry blossom
trees. They must be in full
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Cherry blossoms really are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's their fleeting beauty that makes the
sight of
falling petals so special.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ... Cough.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I should learn from them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I have to be lovelier and
more striking
than anyone else.
Otherwise, no one will
remember me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's make the Sprinters Stakes
our next
race.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll run so well it'll bring you to tears, just
like last
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next race goal is the Sprinters
Stakes, where
we'll surely bask in cheers
as loud as last year's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stop by a clinic a few days after the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen to have some
tests
done... but apparently, there's
nothing wrong with
her.
